verdict.rationale: Increase models each customer as an Entity and exposes Entity validations through the API for each version of the data, so some customer verification is programmatic. The pack does not show the rest of the story: no document collection, no watchlist screening, no separate KYC/KYB flows, and no modeled application states. missing for 10: document collection, watchlist/sanctions screening, explicit KYC vs KYB flows, clearly modeled application/verification states, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, customer verification is programmatic — KYC for individuals and KYB for businesses with document collection, watchlist screening, and clearly modeled application states

citations.quote: Increase makes Entity validations available via the API for each version of the data.
You represent each of your customers as an Entity.
